The P-Value is approximately 0.0906, which is
not less than the significance level 0.05. So, we
fail to reject the null hypothesis that the mean is
1240. There is not enough evidence to conclude
that the mean is larger than 1240.
Many technologies, including STATBELT, offer a shortcut that allows us to run the test without
computing the test statistic first, as we did in examples 5 and 6. STATBELT and similar apps will ask
you to input the hypotheses and the sample mean, standard deviation, and sample size, then will compute
the test statistic and P-Value for you. These are commonly called t-tests in technology menus.
